_comment: Power Automate flow definitions for Plant Delivery & Office Inventory Management. Import each flow definition individually via make.powerautomate.com > Import > Import Package, or via Power Platform CLI.

flows.name: OrderConfirmationNotification
flows.description: Triggered from Power Apps when a user submits an order. Retrieves order details and notifies the requester via Teams adaptive card and email.

inputs.name: orderNumber
inputs.description: The auto-generated Order Number of the newly created order.

actions.name: GetOrder
actions.description: Retrieve the Order record matching the supplied Order Number.

actions.name: GetOrderItems
actions.description: Retrieve all Order Item rows related to this order.

actions.name: SendConfirmationEmail
actions.description: Send an HTML confirmation email to the requester listing the ordered items.

config.subject: Order Confirmation — @{first(outputs('GetOrder')?['body/value'])?['lic_ordernumber']}
config.body:
Hi @{first(outputs('GetOrder')?['body/value'])?['lic_requestedby/fullname']},

Your plant delivery order @{first(outputs('GetOrder')?['body/value'])?['lic_ordernumber']} has been received and is currently Pending.

You will receive another notification when the status changes.

Regards,
Plant Delivery Team

actions.name: PostTeamsAdaptiveCard
actions.description: Post an adaptive card to the Notifications Teams channel summarising the new order.

flows.name: LowStockAlert
flows.description: Runs daily at 6 AM. Checks for inventory items below the reorder threshold and notifies the Warehouse team via Teams and email.

actions.name: ListLowStockItems
actions.description: Retrieve all Inventory rows where Quantity In Stock is less than Reorder Threshold.

actions.name: ConditionAnyLowStock
actions.description: Check whether any low-stock items were returned.

if_true.name: SendLowStockEmail
if_true.description: Email the Warehouse team with the list of low-stock items.

config.subject: ⚠️ Low Stock Alert — Action Required
config.body:
The following plants are below their reorder threshold:

    @{join(select(outputs('ListLowStockItems')?['body/value'], item => concat('
  • ', item?['lic_plantname'], ' — In Stock: ', item?['lic_quantityinstock'], ' / Threshold: ', item?['lic_reorderthreshold'], '
    • ')), '')}

Please arrange restocking as soon as possible.

if_true.name: PostLowStockTeamsMessage
if_true.description: Post a message to the Warehouse Teams channel listing low-stock items.

config.message:
⚠️ **Low Stock Alert**

The following plants need restocking:
@{join(select(outputs('ListLowStockItems')?['body/value'], item => concat('• ', item?['lic_plantname'], ' (', item?['lic_quantityinstock'], ' in stock, threshold: ', item?['lic_reorderthreshold'], ')')), '
')}

if_false.name: Terminate
if_false.description: No low-stock items — end the flow gracefully.

flows.name: OrderStatusChangedNotification
flows.description: Triggered when an Orders row is updated in Dataverse. If the Status column has changed, notifies the original requester via Teams and email.

config._comment: The 'filtering_attributes' field limits trigger firing to Status column changes only, reducing unnecessary flow runs.

actions.name: GetUpdatedOrder
actions.description: Retrieve the full updated Order record including requester details.

actions.name: SendStatusChangeEmail
actions.description: Notify the requester that their order status has been updated.

config.subject: Order Status Update — @{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_ordernumber']}
config.body:
Hi @{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_requestedby/fullname']},

The status of your order @{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_ordernumber']} has been updated to @{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_status@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue']}.

Regards,
Plant Delivery Team

actions.name: PostStatusChangeTeamsMessage
actions.description: Send a 1:1 Teams chat message to the requester with the new status.

config.message: 📦 Your order **@{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_ordernumber']}** status has changed to **@{outputs('GetUpdatedOrder')?['body/lic_status@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue']}**.
